moment: You did not want to be measured. You did not want to be the subject of a reading you did not choose to be in. And you have just refused the reading, and the refusal holds, and the record stands unfinished, and the cost of the refusal is the one cat in this room who was not a subject until the ledger made him one. Not quiet. Still.
style: Engraved etching illustration, dense crosshatching, fine ink linework, monochrome, no colour. Heavy blacks, high contrast, deep shadow, dark inked plate. The characters are anthropomorphic cats.
